plan: In a single-round sealed bid auction with value $28, my strategy is to bid slightly below my true value to maximize potential profit. Since other bidders have unknown values, I'll aim to bid strategically around $25-$26 to increase my chances of winning while preserving some profit margin. This approach balances winning probability with potential earnings, recognizing that bidding exactly at my value would eliminate all potential profit.

Since the auction will continue until only one bidder remains, I'll bid slightly below my true value to reduce potential losses. A bid around $20-$22 provides a buffer while still giving a chance to win if other bidders bid conservatively. This approach balances risk and potential profit.

With a private value of $36, my goal is to maximize potential profit. In a sealed bid auction with two other bidders, I want to bid strategically.
